title: Glowing watermelon slice
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow aura behind slice -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="42" ry="30" fill="#1a3a1a" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- Rind (outer green) -->
  <path d="M10 45 Q50 95 90 45 Q50 55 10 45 Z" fill="#3ccf4e" stroke="#2a9e3a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Lighter green rind highlight -->
  <path d="M14 47 Q50 92 86 47 Q50 57 14 47 Z" fill="#5ee86e" opacity="0.45"/>
  <!-- Inner white/pale green layer -->
  <path d="M17 45 Q50 85 83 45 Q50 53 17 45 Z" fill="#d4f5d4"/>
  <!-- Red flesh -->
  <path d="M20 45 Q50 78 80 45 Q50 51 20 45 Z" fill="#ff3b4f"/>
  <!-- Flesh highlight for glow -->
  <path d="M24 46 Q50 72 76 46 Q50 50 24 46 Z" fill="#ff6b78" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- Seeds -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="53" rx="1.8" ry="3" fill="#3a1a2a" transform="rotate(-15 38 53)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="57" rx="1.8" ry="3" fill="#3a1a2a"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="53" rx="1.8" ry="3" fill="#3a1a2a" transform="rotate(15 62 53)"/>
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="62" rx="1.5" ry="2.5" fill="#3a1a2a" transform="rotate(-10 44 62)"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="62" rx="1.5" ry="2.5" fill="#3a1a2a" transform="rotate(10 56 62)"/>
  <!-- Cute face on flesh -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="49" rx="2.2" ry="2.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="49" rx="2.2" ry="2.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <ellipse cx="43.5" cy="49.5" rx="1.2" ry="1.6" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <ellipse cx="57.5" cy="49.5" rx="1.2" ry="1.6" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="44.2" cy="48.7" r="0.6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="58.2" cy="48.7" r="0.6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx="37" cy="53" rx="3" ry="1.5" fill="#ff8899" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="63" cy="53" rx="3" ry="1.5" fill="#ff8899" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M46 55 Q50 59 54 55" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
